patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width light backgrounds (cream, white) and full-width vibrant colored backgrounds (green, purple, light blue, light green), creating clear visual breaks.

A highly distinctive, rounded, heavy sans-serif display font is used for the brand logo and key emotional words (e.g., 'together', large 'Board' in footer), contrasting with a more conventional bold sans-serif for other headings and a legible sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast, playful palette is used, combining a warm cream base with vibrant accents of green, deep purple, and bright yellow, often in large blocks or for key elements.

The top announcement bar disappears on scroll, and the main navigation bar transitions from a transparent background to a solid white background, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport. Content sections reveal by scrolling into view without additional complex animations.
Card-based layouts are used for showcasing game examples and product features, featuring consistently rounded corners and often paired with illustrative imagery or icons.

technique_notes: The hero section features an auto-playing video contained within a rounded-corner frame, immediately conveying the product's use case and emotional appeal.

The global navigation bar uses a scroll-triggered transformation: initially transparent, it gains a solid white background and sticks to the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections that simply scroll into view, using varied background colors to differentiate them visually without complex reveal animations.

fonts.family: similar-to: custom display sans-serif with rounded, heavy forms

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body) establish a clear hierarchy, with a unique, rounded display font for key brand elements and a standard sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, image frames, and card elements, creating a soft and friendly aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between sections, with balanced padding within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive through its playful and energetic brand identity, achieved by combining a high-contrast, vibrant color palette with a unique, rounded display typography for the brand name and key emotional messages. This creates a memorable and friendly impression that stands apart from generic templates.
